acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 在感染已完成適當治療且病況穩定後，可僅以疼痛、壓力或功能困擾的輔助症狀照護為目標。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 不得以針灸治療活動性感染；發燒、急性骨盆痛或妊娠可能性須先依紅旗流程處理。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與婦產科／初級照護共同管理；不得延誤抗生素、性伴侶處置或不孕／子宮外孕風險評估。
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未找到可支持本病療效宣稱的病種專屬針灸指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: After infection has been appropriately treated and the condition is stable, acupuncture may only be considered for adjunctive symptom care such as pain, stress, or functional burden.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Do not use acupuncture to treat active infection; fever, acute pelvic pain, or possible pregnancy requires red-flag evaluation first.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage with gynecology or primary care; do not delay antibiotics, partner management, or evaluation of infertility or ectopic-pregnancy risk.
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was identified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 可在排除腰椎神經根病變及其他深臀病因後，作為疼痛與活動受限的輔助照護。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 避免在未釐清進行性無力、感覺缺損或膀胱腸道症狀時深刺臀區。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 持續或有神經缺損者與復健醫學、骨科或神經科共同管理。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: May be considered as adjunctive care for pain and activity limitation after lumbar radiculopathy and other deep-gluteal causes are assessed.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Avoid deep gluteal needling when progressive weakness, sensory loss, or bowel/bladder symptoms have not been evaluated.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage persistent cases or neurologic deficits with rehabilitation medicine, orthopedics, or neurology.
acupuncture_scope_en.source: PubMed systematic review — Four symptoms define piriformis syndrome

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 僅可作為壓力、睡眠或疼痛等症狀的輔助照護，不宣稱可取代 PMDD 診斷與標準治療。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 每次確認自傷／自殺風險與躁期症狀；急性風險時停止常規治療並啟動危機流程。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與婦產科及心理健康專業人員共同管理；藥物不得自行停改。
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未找到可支持本病療效宣稱的病種專屬針灸指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: May only be used as adjunctive symptom care for stress, sleep, or pain; it does not replace PMDD diagnosis or standard treatment.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Screen each time for self-harm or suicide risk and manic symptoms; stop routine care and activate crisis procedures for acute risk.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage with gynecology and mental-health professionals; do not independently stop or alter medication.
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was identified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 僅能作母親壓力、疼痛或放鬆的輔助照護；不以針灸保證增加乳量。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 先評估母嬰感染、乳房炎／膿瘍、產後出血、嬰兒脫水、黃疸及體重問題。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與婦產科、兒科及國際認證泌乳顧問共同管理；不得延誤餵養補充計畫。
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未找到可支持本病療效宣稱的病種專屬針灸指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: May be used only as adjunctive care for maternal stress, pain, or relaxation; do not promise increased milk production.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: First assess maternal/infant infection, mastitis or abscess, postpartum hemorrhage, and infant dehydration, jaundice, or weight concerns.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage with obstetrics, pediatrics, and a qualified lactation consultant; do not delay a feeding or supplementation plan.
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was identified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 可作為已評估之肌腱病變疼痛與功能復健的輔助照護。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 急性外傷後明顯無力、脫位疑慮或全層撕裂疑慮未評估前，不在局部做強刺激。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與物理治療、復健醫學或骨科共同管理；針灸不取代漸進負荷復健。
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未找到可支持本病療效宣稱的病種專屬針灸指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: May be considered adjunctive care for pain and rehabilitation in an evaluated rotator-cuff tendinopathy.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Avoid strong local stimulation before marked post-traumatic weakness, suspected dislocation, or full-thickness tear has been evaluated.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage with physical therapy, rehabilitation medicine, or orthopedics; acupuncture does not replace progressive-loading rehabilitation.
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was identified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 確立病因並穩定後，可僅針對疼痛、噁心或壓力作輔助照護。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 異常大量出血、妊娠可能、急性單側痛、發燒或昏厥須先轉診；孕期避免未經評估的腹骶部刺激。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與婦產科共同管理內膜異位、腺肌症、肌瘤或 PID；不得用症狀緩解取代病因追蹤。
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未找到可支持本病療效宣稱的病種專屬針灸指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: After the underlying cause is established and stable, acupuncture may be considered only for adjunctive care of pain, nausea, or stress.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Heavy abnormal bleeding, possible pregnancy, acute unilateral pain, fever, or syncope requires referral first; avoid unassessed abdominal or sacral stimulation in pregnancy.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage endometriosis, adenomyosis, fibroids, or PID with gynecology; symptom relief must not replace etiologic follow-up.
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was identified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 針灸不治療 Candida 感染；診斷與抗真菌治療完成後，至多作非感染性不適的輔助照護。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 不在感染黏膜或破損皮膚局部施針；孕期、復發或複雜病例須先由醫療人員評估。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與婦產科／初級照護共同管理，避免僅憑症狀自我診斷或延誤檢驗治療。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Acupuncture does not treat Candida infection; after diagnosis and antifungal treatment, it may at most support noninfectious residual discomfort.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Do not needle infected mucosa or broken skin; pregnancy and recurrent or complicated cases require medical assessment first.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage with gynecology or primary care and avoid symptom-only self-diagnosis or delay of testing and treatment.

acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 未排除骨折、不穩定、脊髓／神經損傷或血管性症狀前，避免頸部深刺與強力手法。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: After trauma and neurologic assessment, acupuncture may be considered adjunctive care for pain and return of movement.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Avoid deep cervical needling and forceful techniques until fracture, instability, spinal cord or nerve injury, and vascular symptoms have been excluded.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage with emergency care, rehabilitation medicine, physical therapy, or orthopedics according to severity.
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was identified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.
